tha-ap47:1.1: Pañcahatthiya.] Sumedho nāma sambuddho gacchate antarāpaṇe / khittacakkhu mitabhāṇī satimā saṃvutindriyo. // //
tha-ap47:2.1: Pañcauppalahatthāni āveḷattham akāsi me / tena Buddhaṃ apūjesiṃ pasanno sehi pāṇihi. // //
tha-ap47:3.1: Āropitā ca te pupphā chādanaṃ assu satthuno / saṃsāviṃsu mahānāgaṃ sissā ācariyaṃ yathā. // //
tha-ap47:4.1: Tiṃsakappasahassamhi yaṃ puppham abhiropayiṃ / duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi Buddhapūjāy' idaṃ phalaṃ. // //
tha-ap47:5.1: Ito vīsaṃkappasate ahesuṃ pañca khattiyā / Hatthiyā nāma nāmena cakkavattī mahabbalā. // //
tha-ap47:6.1: Paṭisambhidā catasso vimokhā pi ca aṭṭh' ime / chaḷabhiññā sacchikatā kataṃ Buddhassa sāsanan
tha-ap47:7.1: ti. // // Itthaṃ sudaṃ āyasmā Pañcahatthiyo thero imā gāthāyo abhāsitthā ti.
